basics.name: Dmitry Rybalka
basics.label: Lead Product Designer
basics.summary: Product design leader with 15+ years of hands-on UX/UI and product design experience since January 2011. Leads Product Design, UX Research, DesignOps, and Design Systems at Larixon Classifieds. Experience spans FinTech, marketplaces, classifieds, HealthTech, leasing, e-commerce, travel, gaming, and automotive services. Open to remote work or relocation.

work.name: Larixon Classifieds
work.summary: International classifieds group with market-leading platforms across Cyprus, Mongolia, Tajikistan, Trinidad and Tobago, and Jamaica. Project markets include Cyprus, Mongolia, Tajikistan, Trinidad and Tobago, and Jamaica.
highlights: Developed the design function across Product Design, DesignOps, Design Systems, and UX Research.
Led a team of 7 Product Designers and 1 UX Research Lead across 8+ product verticals.
Built the Design System from 0 to 1 for Web and App, including DSO roles, governance, and a maturity tracker.
Launched UX Research from 0 to 1 across Cyprus, Mongolia, and Tajikistan, including cross-country studies.
Defined design strategy, linking design initiatives to business goals.
Established OKR-based DesignOps, design reviews, Jira visibility, onboarding, and individual development plans (IDPs).
Introduced AI-assisted workflows for discovery, ideation, documentation, and automation.

work.name: Raiffeisen Bank Russia
work.summary: Trading and investment products at the Russian bank, part of Raiffeisen Bank International Group. Product work included a professional terminal serving 500+ institutional clients.
highlights: Led UX for a professional trading terminal serving 500+ institutional clients.
Defined product design strategy across 5+ tools, aligning business goals with user needs.
Mentored 5 designers, conducted design reviews, and supported hiring across 2 product teams.
Used LLM-powered tools to accelerate research preparation, synthesize insights, and explore early hypotheses.

work.name: Raiffeisen Leasing
work.summary: B2B leasing marketplace and internal CRM workflows for sales teams, business clients, and dealers.
highlights: Designed a B2B leasing marketplace and modular CRM for 19 role types and 350+ sales representatives.
Cut offer generation time from 12 to 2 minutes by redesigning quoting workflows and UI logic.
Increased process automation from 10% to 90% by streamlining business rules and operational flows.
Contributed to defining and implementing the Triple Diamond design process for an organization of 40+ designers.

work.name: Yandex.Market
work.summary: Large-scale e-commerce marketplace work across analytics products, seller-facing tools, vendor onboarding workflows, and product taxonomy.
highlights: Led UX for a large-scale analytics platform used by product and category teams.
Reduced vendor onboarding time from 90 days to 1 day by redesigning agreement workflows.
Designed seller tools for 35,000 marketplace vendors.
Improved product taxonomy and categorization for 57M SKUs covering 890 marketplace categories.

work.name: GdeMaterial
work.summary: Early-stage DIY marketplace for construction and home improvement materials.
highlights: Led UX for a DIY marketplace startup with 500+ suppliers and 2K B2B clients.
Built and launched mtrl.pro, a B2B platform for construction and wholesale clients.
Increased conversion from 0.5% to 1.6% through product page and checkout redesign.
Launched purchase and logistics workflows, including real-time communication between suppliers and buyers.

work.name: Medesk Ltd.
work.summary: B2B HealthTech SaaS platform used by healthcare providers across 35 countries.
highlights: Designed UX for a healthcare platform used by 1000 clinics across 35 countries.
Launched an online treatment flow for 10K B2C patients.
Improved NPS from 37 to 54.
Integrated 10 third-party modules and 5 medical laboratories.
Designed and developed the design system using Storybook-based UI components.

highlights: Launched a marketplace from scratch with more than 54,000 watch SKUs and over 173 brands.
Designed a B2B system for more than 200 offline stores and 10 online shops.
Developed and launched a high-conversion email marketing strategy.
Increased browsing depth from 3 to 6.

highlights: Designed product interfaces for the pre-seed fundraising stage; the round raised $400K.
Created landing pages with an 18% visit-to-registration conversion rate.

Designed a gaming community website.
